newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat gains on firmer U.S. market.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat gains on firmer U.S. market.

text.p: Wheat futures edged higher on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Wednesday with the January 1997 contract settling A$1.50 up at A$164.50 a tonne after forfeiting A$1.00 in the Tuesday session.
March and May wheat also gained, as did the far-forward January and March 1998 contracts.

Activity was underpinned by continuing firmness in U.S. wheat prices and technical support markers suggesting prices may have bottomed out for a while, traders said. Despite recent price gains, though, longer term traders said they wheat prices trading lower on expectations of a big harvest.
